chain.to: module pointer table; only module index0 is in scope; no vector header/capacity inferred

page_container.kind: Native list-like circular doubly linked sequence of 4-byte key/4-byte page value pairs; not a13-element contiguous array
page_container.end: sentinel pointer; never treat sentinel pair bytes as a page

bounds.expected_count: Use exact fresh baseline catalog,13 for the current controlled fixture; not version dependent

target_scope.nested_groups: Out of scope for minimal field60 sampler; reject unexpected group/nesting instead of invoking IObject.Children.

lazy_rule.if_NULL: Report unloaded; do not invoke loader or infer live field values from stored wire values.
lazy_rule.if_nonNULL: Require C0DocUser exact vtable/COL/RTTI; then read existing+2BC only.

read_only_consistency_contract: Only OpenProcess QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|VM_READ + ReadProcessMemory, no remote execution/Frida/suspend/context changes.
Pin exact PID creation FILETIME, canonical process image and full EXE SHA, module PE ranges; read all complete HIGHLOW-aware code guards and exact table COL/RTTI ASCII+NUL.
Read global app/root/path before and after each sample; fixture identity must be exact; no prior-PID constants reused.
Validate page circular list count, sentinel, forward/back links, unique nodes/page pointers/archive IDs; terminate after exact count and require return to sentinel.
Validate control list count, first.prev=NULL, last.next=NULL, forward/back links, unique nodes/complete pointers, final node==tail and owner complete+64==doc.
Read only known control name metadata, state+60 and optional raw rect; do not call generic getObjectID or read account/password/business text.

Read complete bounded snapshot twice and require exact equality, including headers and path; this detects many races but is not a global atomic snapshot guarantee. If different, mark unstable and stop; no automatic mutation/retry.
